rouge_failure_worked_example.reference: No problem! If you don't have a printer, generate your returns label and click on the E-mail to a friend button, this way you can have someone print it on your behalf if possible.
rouge_failure_worked_example.hypothesis: Sorry to hear you're having trouble with printing a return label! No printer? No problem! Generate your return label, then email it to a friend or family member who can print it for you. Alternatively, use a public printer at a library. Hope this helps!
